---
paths:
  - "examples/*/src/**"
---

### Generated files (`examples/*/src/`)
Files regenerated by `JuceStandaloneGenerator/generate-juce-standalone.py` (Processor.h, Editor.h, PatchParameters.h, StubImpl.h, FileIo.h, Constants.h, CcMapping.h, CcSettings.h, UiElements.h, and every shared header under `src/inc/` such as ScriptEditorWindow.h, AppSettings.h, LuaScriptEngineBase.h, LlmAssistWatcher.h, LlmAssistWatcherCore.h) must **not** be edited by hand, in any example. All UI and parameter changes go in the blueprint JSON (`JuceStandaloneGenerator/blueprints/<name>.json`); logic changes shared across examples go in `JuceStandaloneGenerator/templates/sourcefiles/` (static template text) or `JuceStandaloneGenerator/codegen_processor.py` (Python-generated sections, e.g. per-symbol script/patch pool methods); then re-run the generator. The implementation file (`impl/<Name>Impl.h`) is hand-written and is never overwritten by the generator.

Before hand-editing any file under `examples/*/src/`, check whether its name appears in the
list above or has a same-named counterpart under `JuceStandaloneGenerator/templates/sourcefiles/`
(including subfolders like `inc/`, `impl/`). If it does, edit the template (and/or
`codegen_processor.py`) and regenerate instead - never patch the generated copy directly, even
for a small or urgent-feeling fix. Hand-editing generated files lets `examples/*/src/` silently
drift out of sync with its template; the fix is not a follow-up "port forward it later" step,
it is to never let the drift happen. This was violated repeatedly in the dronesequencer script
editor / LLM-Assist work (several rounds of direct hand-edits to ScriptEditorWindow.h, FileIo.h,
DronesequencerProcessor.h, DronesequencerEditor.h, LuaScriptEngineBase.h, LlmAssistWatcher.h
before the drift was caught and had to be reverse-engineered back into the generator).
